name: 30 Pack - 30x1g Pre-roll - Tribute 13
description:
Thirty joints, one box. The 30 Pack Tribute 13 gives you thirty full-gram pre-rolls — 30 grams total — rolled with quality flower and ready to smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no running out. Just grab one and go.

Tribute 13 brings a bold, well-rounded profile: sweet fruit and subtle dessert notes up front, grounded by an earthy, gassy backbone and a smooth finish. It's a flavorful, easygoing smoke — mellow and satisfying, with the kind of balanced character that works just as well for a quick session as a long one.

Why you'll love it:

30 × 1G pre-rolls — 30 grams total, serious value in one box
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Tribute 13 flavor — sweet fruit and dessert notes with an earthy, gassy finish
Smooth, balanced effects — mellow and easygoing, great any time of day

Big value, dependable quality, and everyday convenience in every box. The 30 Pack Tribute 13 is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
